node.description:
__Height:__ 167 cm (5'5")
__Talent:__ ???

Kyouko is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. Her talent is unknown.

Kyouko is a mysterious, stoic, and independent person who deliberately masks her feelings so that others won't be able to read her. Because of this, she has a cold demeanor and appears to remain calm and collected in most situations. Despite this, however, she can sometimes let her emotions get the best of her when she's especially upset. Though aloof and slow to trust others, Kyouko is adept at noticing things that the other students don't, which proves vital once bodies start turning up. She often advises [Makoto](https://anilist.co/character/63851/Naegi-Makoto) on conducting investigations.

~!Her actual talent is the Super High School Level Detective, or the Ultimate Detective in the English localization.!~

alternative: Chou Koukou Kyuu no Kou'un (超高校級の幸運)
Super High School Level Good Luck

node.description:
__Height:__ 180 cm (5'11")
__Talent:__ Ultimate Lucky Student

Nagito is a student of Hope's Peak Academy's Class 77-B, and a participant of the Killing School Trip. 

On the surface, Nagito is friendly and easygoing. He genuinely cares for his classmates and holds a lot of respect for ideals like love, friendship, and teamwork. However, he doesn't care for "ordinary, untalented people" such as himself and is extremely self-deprecating; he sees himself as "worthless trash" whose life has no value, something he brings up often. Nagito is also highly intelligent, usually solving the murders long before anyone else, though he doesn't share his findings easily.

Nagito has an extreme, twisted obsession with hope. He believes that hope is an absolute good that will always win in the end, and that anything done in the name of hope, even murder, is virtuous. He sees Ultimates as the embodiments of hope that are chosen at birth, and thinks they can strengthen that hope by facing and overcoming despair. He doesn't consider himself to be a "real" Ultimate, and instead wishes to sacrifice himself so that they can shine.

alternative: Chou Koukou Kyuu no Gamer (超高校級のゲーマー)

node.description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'2")
__Talent:__ Ultimate Gamer

A student of Hope's Peak Academy's Class 77-B, and a participant of the Killing School Trip. 

Chiaki normally has a quiet and sleepy disposition, but she becomes a lot more lively when discussing games and concentrates hard when playing. She has a number of unusual habits, such as dozing off while playing games and taking long pauses during her conversations to think about everything she wants to say. She sometimes even sleeps while standing and forgets to breathe when she's playing games. She also quite often uses gaming terms and references, and has a habit of ending her sentences with an uncertain note, such as with "...I think", or "Maybe...". [Hajime](https://anilist.co/character/90007/Hinata-Hajime) has told her that he wishes she had a more positive catchphrase.

Chiaki is very calm, and she once mentioned that she has never screamed. She often helps Hajime Hinata during the Class Trials and provides important points. She can be stern and bluntly honest, even at times forgetting to take other people's feelings into consideration. However, Chiaki truly does care about and wants to protect everyone. She dislikes killing more than anything and she gets very serious about the topic. She is the nicest towards [Monomi](https://anilist.co/character/73237/Monomi) and she is very understanding towards [Nagito Komaeda](https://anilist.co/character/73227/Komaeda-Nagito), even though his actions frustrate her.

~!Nanami is actually revealed to be an AI created by Alter Ego to be a mole for the Future Foundation.!~

alternative: Chou Koukou Kyuu no Gal (超高校級のギャル)

node.description:
__Height:__ 169 cm (5'7")
__Talent:__ Gyaru

Junko is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant in the Killing School Life. She is the Super High School Level Gyaru, or Ultimate Fashionista in the English localization.

Junko is talkative, charismatic, and can be hotheaded at times.

~!It is discovered that the girl who introduced herself as Junko wasn't really Junko at all, but actually Mukuro Ikusaba, her twin sister, the Ultimate Soldier. She was the "victim" of the fifth murder, her body having been used to create a fake crime scene. The real Junko, the younger twin who she switched places with, was the mastermind behind Monokuma, as well as the Tragedy.!~

~!Junko's real personality and mannerisms are erratic and unstable, switching through several "personalities" at the drop of a hat, which she says is because she gets bored easily. Junko is incredibly manipulative and cunning, having orchestrated the Tragedy. She is obsessed with despair and finds it to be the most enjoyable emotion in the world.!~

~!It is eventually revealed that her true talent is that of Super High School Level Analytical Prowess. This ability allows her to quickly analyze her surroundings with superhuman speed, detailed thinking, and memorization, giving her the ability to predict the future with near-perfect accuracy, as well as be able to learn and understand new skills by just seeing it once. This ability is also what gave Junko her "Ultimate Fashionista" title: because she's able to predict trends, she can predict what will become popular with society.!~

name.native: セレスティア・ルーデンベルク

Celestia is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. She is the Super High School Level Gambler, or the Ultimate Gambler in the English localization.

Also known as the "Queen of Liars", Celestia is renowned for her exemplary luck in games of chance. She's accumulated a sizable fortune by robbing anyone stupid enough to challenge her blind. She speaks softly and smiles often, but in a way that tends to creep out everyone around her. She also hides a surprisingly short temper and will start shouting (usually at [Hifumi](https://anilist.co/character/65535/Yamada-Hifumi)) if she isn't pleased.  

~!Her true name is Taeko Yasuhiro.!~

Makoto is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. His talent is Super High School Level Good Luck (超高校級の幸運), meaning he got into Hope's Peak by winning a lottery, rather than being scouted for an extraordinary talent like everyone else. His title is the Ultimate Lucky Student in the English localization.

Makoto is friendly and a lot more down-to-earth than other students. He tends to act passively in conversation. According to him, his most distinguishing feature is his optimism.

__Height:__ 75 cm (2'6") (DR1 & DRV3), 65 cm (2'2") (DR2)

A stuffed robotic bear and the self-proclaimed Headmaster of Hope's Peak Academy who instigates the various killing games in the Danganronpa series. Monokuma is often described as easygoing and cheerful at first glance, but with a very sinister undertone.. He loves hysteria, violence, chaos, and most of all, despair.

node.description:
__Height:__ 165 cm  (5'5")
__Talent:__ Literature

Touko is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. She is the Super High School Level Literary Girl, or the Ultimate Writing Prodigy in the English localization.

Due to her severe persecution complex that originates from the bullying she suffered at a young age, Touko is highly suspicious of other people, frequently accusing them of thinking bad things about her. She has also caused others to give a bad first impression of her as she is known to blatantly insult others, even though it is the very first time they have met. Despite her young age, she has already won several awards for her writing, and her works are constantly on top of selling lists. She is also in love with [Byakuya Togami](https://anilist.co/character/65541/Togami-Byakuya), constantly swooning over him and acting extremely submissive towards him, although her affection is one-sided.

~!Touko actually has two different identities, the other being the infamous serial killer, Genocider Sho.!~

node.description:
__Height:__ 179 cm (5'10")
__Talent:__ Ultimate ???

A student of Hope's Peak Academy's Class 77-B, and a participant of the Killing School Trip featured in Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair. He doesn't remember his talent at the beginning of the Killing Game, so his title is the Ultimate ???.

Hajime seems cynical at first glance, but it would be better to describe him as a realist. He is quite skeptical and tends to worry more than the other students, but his worries are usually understandable. He is logical and smart; often annoyed by the idea of not being able to understand someone or something at all. He tends to be quite serious, but he does joke around and often goes along with his classmates' eccentric hobbies anyway, and sometimes smiles awkwardly and sheepishly while his friends engage in some of their usual weird behavior. He is sometimes annoyed by some of his classmates and can be snarky towards them in his thoughts as well as blunt while speaking to them, though he's more frank than sarcastic or mean-spirited. Though sometimes a bit submissive (especially with bossy girls), he is not afraid to speak his mind, and he can be rude if annoyed enough (for example, after enduring [Hiyoko](https://anilist.co/character/90017/Saionji-Hiyoko)'s attitude during her Free Time Events, he finally ends up stating "I don't even care anymore"). He can sometimes be short-tempered and snap at others, especially when he's tired or under pressure. He was also quite paranoid during the start of the game and didn't have much interest in friendship, but he later really wanted to believe in his classmates and felt bad about doubting them during the Class Trials, though he understood it was necessary.

~!It was revealed in Chapter 4 by Nagito Komaeda that Hajime was actually a reserve course student who had no talent whatsoever and is not an Ultimate himself.!~

alternative: Chou Koukou Kyuu no Onzoushi (超高校級の御曹司)

Byakuya is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. He is the Super High School Level Heir, or the Ultimate Affluent Progeny in the English localization.

Byakuya is arrogant, seeing himself superior to his peers due to having fought to become the heir to his family's massive financial conglomerate. However, he is a sensible student who holds a truthful, albeit cynical, outlook on the world. He is ruthlessly honest about his opinions and often hurts others with his blunt remarks. Despite his negative attitude, he does occasionally lend a hand to other characters.

node.description:
__Height:__ 182 cm (5'11")
__Talent:__ Ultimate Animal Breeder

A student of Hope's Peak Academy's Class 77-B, and a participant of the Killing School Trip. He is almost always seen with his extremely well-trained hamsters, the Four Dark Devas of Destruction: San-D (orange and white), Jum-P (grey and white), Maga-Z (tan fur with peach underbelly, chipped ear), and Cham-P (fat, orange). 

Gundham is an eccentric chuunibyou who claims that he has been blessed with the evil powers of the underworld, referring to everyone else as "pathetic human beings" and often rambling about the dark arts, alchemy, and astral levels. He is often lost in his own world, paying more attention to himself and his hamsters than the things going on around him. Because of this, Gundham initially comes off as self-centered and aloof, however he seems to have serious problems with socializing and physical contact. He has been strict about not wanting to touch nor be touched by others since childhood, going as far as to avoid sports and playing with other children. In his typical manner, Gundham claims that his flesh is "poisoned" to disguise his fear of intimacy. He tells [Hajime](https://anilist.co/character/90007/Hinata-Hajime) that he can only be touched by very specific persons with astral levels that match his own.

Though he may be awkward around other people, Gundham deeply cares about animals (despite how he refers to them as his evil minions to stay in line with his overlord persona). He claims that anything that can talk "will eventually betray you" and prefers to trust animals for their loyalty and sincere nature. He has an informational website about breeding which he maintains carefully. He also gets offended when anyone looks down on the Devas or refers to them as simply average hamsters, as he claims that hamsters are merely their "temporary form".

alternative: Chou Koukou Kyuu no Programmer (超高校級のプログラマー)

node.description:
__Height:__ 148 cm (4'9")
__Talent:__ Programming

A student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. Chihiro is the Super High School Level Programmer, or the Ultimate Programmer in the English localization.

Chihiro is a computer genius behind numerous innovative software. Has a very timid, meek personality, crying easily and apologizing often. However, Chihiro loves to talk about programming and becomes much livelier when it's brought up. 

As a kid, Chihiro spent most of the time on the computer. Chihiro's father, [Taichi Fujisaki](https://anilist.co/character/174957/Fujisaki-Taichi), was a software engineer who developed many major computer programs. While using his computer one day, Chihiro ended up modifying one of Taichi's incomplete programs and soon realized that she could write programs, after that, Chihiro became absorbed in programming and became famous for creating cutting-edge programs, including top-secret AI programs for an unnamed company, and gained many fans for resembling a "timid little bunny".

alternative: Chou Koukou Kyuu no Swimmer (超高校級のスイマー)

node.description:
__Height:__ 157 cm (5'1")
__Talent:__ Ultimate Yakuza

A student of Hope's Peak Academy's Class 77-B, and a participant of the Killing School Trip featured in _Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair_. 

Fuyuhiko is initially incredibly stand-offish and rude to the other students. When he does interact with them, his attitude is combative and irritable. He was born as the heir of Kuzuryu Clan, but he thinks that his younger sister, [Natsumi](https://anilist.co/character/165731/Kuzuryuu-Natsumi), deserves the title instead. Fuyuhiko states that he wants to be strong on his own and not rely on his family's power to get ahead. His goal is to be strong enough to lead his family, rather than to be strong _because_ he leads his family. He takes duty very seriously, and if there's someone who he can trust, he will open his heart and cooperate with them.

Despite being a yakuza, Fuyuhiko has a somewhat pure heart and is very strict to the rules, taking honor and moral codes seriously. He is also particularly sensitive about his "baby face" looks.

alternative: Chou Koukou Kyuu no Mechanic (超高校級のメカニック)

node.description:
__Height:__ 172 cm (5'6")
__Talent:__ Ultimate Mechanic

A student of Hope's Peak Academy's Class 77-B, and a participant of the Killing School Trip. 

Kazuichi is a highly emotional character, though he tries to play it smooth and acts carefree at first. He is a very jumpy person, easily scared and often screaming in fear. People tend to note his intimidating appearance does not match his compulsive and cowardly personality. Naturally, he has a great fear of dying on the island during the Killing School Trip, which causes a lot of stress and panic for him. He also often blurts things out without thinking, seems to be a very bad liar, and tends to be slow-witted. Alongside [Mikan Tsumiki](https://anilist.co/character/90008/Tsumiki-Mikan), Kazuichi often ends up being the butt of [Monokuma](https://anilist.co/character/73235/Monokuma) and [Hiyoko Saionji](https://anilist.co/character/90017/Saionji-Hiyoko)'s jokes.

Kazuichi tends to carry around a wrench and he gets anxious if he cannot tinker with something. He has a great love for machinery, especially fast ones like rockets and bikes, which is ironic, since he suffers from awful motion sickness. He also likes girls a lot, though in a rather perverted and shallow way. He has taken a strong liking to [Sonia Nevermind](https://anilist.co/character/90015/Nevermind-Sonia), to an extent of being a pervert, and in constant jealousy of [Gundham Tanaka](https://anilist.co/character/73213/Tanaka-Gundham). He claims that he's dreamed of a beautiful blonde girlfriend since he was a kid. Sonia dislikes this behavior and calls him a stalker.

alternative: Chou Koukou Kyuu no Kendouka (超高校級の剣道家)

node.description:
__Height:__ 172 cm (5'6")

A student of Hope's Peak Academy Class 77-B, and a participant of the Killing School Trip featured in  _Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair_. 

Peko initially appears to be rather serious and intimidating, expressing little emotion. However, she isn't unsociable and doesn't mean to act cold. For a long time she didn't smile because she thought it was unnecessary, and she says she eventually forgot how to. Even though she doesn't believe it herself, she is a very kindhearted and selfless person  who cares about her classmates, wishing nothing but good for them. She also loves animals, especially pandas, but most animals are scared of her and tend to run away.

~!During the Killing School Life, Mukuro disguised as her younger twin sister, Junko Enoshima, and joined the remaining fifteen students to carry out Junko's plan. However, Mukuro ended up being killed by her: shortly after the first murder, Mukuro was supposed to follow a plan she had agreed on with her sister, but on a whim, Junko decided to kill her for real and Mukuro was brutally impaled by Monokuma with numerous spears, dubbed "Heavenly Spear, Gungnir". This incident misled the other students into thinking that “Junko” was killed.!~

Super High School Level Marial Artist

node.description:
__Height:__ 192 cm (6'4")
__Talent:__ Martial Arts

Sakura is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. She is the Super High School Level Martial Artist (超高校級の格闘家), or Ultimate Martial Artist in the English localization.

Contrary to what her appearance might suggest, Sakura is a kind and level-headed girl. She rarely loses her nerve and seems able to maintain clarity in almost any situation. During more rare moments, she can lose her temper completely and become extremely intense, particularly when her friends get hurt. She also gets impatient if she cannot properly train for a long period of time. She is known for her love of protein and enjoys exercising early in the morning before a large breakfast.

Due to her more old-fashioned upbringing, Sakura has a habit of talking in an old-fashioned, formal manner. Being raised as the sole heir to a dojo with a three-hundred-year history, she believes that being a martial artist is simply her destiny. Along with learning martial arts, she learned to respect nature and animals, being particularly fond of rabbits as they never seem to get frightened when she holds them.

Along with protecting her legacy as her sworn duty, Sakura wants to prove that a woman can be the Strongest Person Alive. She also believes that she must work harder than men to achieve this goal. As a result of striving to be strong, Sakura is embarrassed about her own softer feelings and being feminine, assuming that other people would laugh at her if they knew.

alternative: Chou Koukou Kyuu no Fuuki Iin (超高校級の風紀委員)
Super High School Level Public Morals

node.description:
__Height:__ 176 cm (5'9")
__Talent:__ Disciplinary Committee Member

Kiyotaka is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. He is the Super High School Level Disciplinary Committee Member (超高校級の風紀委員), or Ultimate Moral Compass in the English localization.

Kiyotaka is righteous and values order above all else. He is also a hard worker, believing that one can achieve anything through hard work. In fact, he earned his title by the same means too. Due to his extreme dedication to studying and proper conduct, he has difficulties in making friends and could not even hold a ‘normal’ conversation with another person. Kiyotaka is very expressive and intense in his manner of speech.

alternative: Chou Koukou Kyuu no Bousouzoku (超高校級の暴走族)

Mondo is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. He is the Super High School Level Biker Gang Leader (超高校級の暴走族), or Ultimate Biker Gang Leader in the English localization.

Mondo is the second leader of the Crazy Diamonds, Japan's largest and most feared biker gang. He has ​high respect for his brother from whom he inherited the gang from after he died. Mondo acts tough and has a strong sense of honor and loyalty to his companions. After he finishes his role as a gang member, he wants to become a carpenter.

alternative: Super High School Level Photographer (超高校級の写真家)

node.description:
__Height:__ 165cm (5'4")
__Talent:__ Ultimate Photographer

A student of Hope's Peak Academy's Class 77-B, and a participant of the Killing School Trip featured in _Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair_. 

Mahiru is optimistic, sensible, and unafraid to speak her mind. She's a reliable person who is prone to taking care of people, but won't hesitate to scold them either. Hajime has likened being scolded by her to being yelled at by his mom. Mahiru has high expectations of men and is quick to be abrasive towards them, while she is much more tolerant and friendly with girls. Likewise, the subjects of her photos are usually girls, as she gets bored photographing guys. Despite her love for photography, Mahiru believes her title is stupid compared to her classmates. She compares her photos to those of her mother, a famous war photographer whose career made her absent for much of Mahiru's life. Mahiru's father was a very poor parent, leaving housework entirely to her. 

(Source: Danganronpa Wiki, edited)

alternative: Super High School Level Pharmacist (超高校級の薬剤師)

node.description:
__Height:__ 160 cm (5'3")
__Talent:__ Ultimate Pharmacist

A former student of Class 76th at Hope's Peak Academy. She is a member of the Future Foundation as the Branch Office 4 Director, responsible for the research and development of new medical techniques. She, along with the other directors, is forced to participate in the Final Killing Game.

Seiko has a reserved personality and a stilted way of speaking. Because she's conscious of how easy it it for people to guess what she's thinking through her facial expressions, she hides her face behind a mask. She's startled easily, often anxious, and has a very soft-hearted nature, being very loyal and forgiving towards people who are kind to her. In high school, Seiko often took requests from other students. She also loves animals, making concoctions specially for helping them. She's very meticulous when dealing with medicine.

As a pharmacist, Seiko has an extensive knowledge of medicine and drugs. She can create just about any kind, ranging from common ones like laxatives and cold medication to more ludicrous ones like strength enhancers that drastically change one's physical appearence. Seiko drew much attention within the pharmaceutical industry, as she had found new uses for pre-existing medicine. Vying for her talent, many companies reached out to her, but she only accepted minimum help with her research.

__Height:__ 176 cm
__Talent:__ Ultimate Gymnast

Akane is a tall, young woman with an athletic, curvaceous physique. 

Akane has a fiery personality and she loves fighting, as long as there is no other weapons besides the person's own fists and body, which lets her get along very well with [Nekomaru Nidai](https://anilist.co/character/90011/Nidai-Nekomaru). She is eager to challenge someone to fight her and she respects those who are physically strong, and can somehow correctly tell which people would be strong opponents even if they don't look like it. She seems to think that punching things, including people, is the best way to solve problems and her hot head can sometimes get her into trouble. While she also loves athletic things such as climbing and running, she can actually be very lazy and unmotivated if she isn't allowed to do things her own way. She dislikes planning, training, and routines, but has a remarkable talent for inventing her own moves. In general, her mood can shift very quickly. She can bounce between bored, to happy, to angry, and to happy again. Despite her easygoing and aloof personality, she is loyal and protective towards her friends.

Akane is also extremely fond of food and she can eat almost anything, including small animals. She claims that food is the most important thing, because "If you don't eat, you'll die." She also thinks that eating is very important so you can regain your strength. While her hungriness is often played for laughs, it has some darker undertones. She says that she quickly loses her energy if she doesn't eat and she just gets more hungry if she eats just a little.

alternative: Super High School-Level Housekeeper (超高校級の家政婦)

node.description:
__Height:__ 161 cm (5'3")
__Talent:__ Ultimate Housekeeper

She was later Class 77-B's homeroom teacher, and then the Future Foundation's Branch 5 Office Director responsible for the inquiry and secret intelligence regarding Despair. She, along with the other Future Foundation Directors, is forced to participate in the Final Killing Game.

alternative: Chou Koukou Kyuu no Uranaishi (超高校級の占い師)
Super Super High School Level Fortune Teller

node.description:
__Height:__ 180 cm (5'11")
__Talent:__ Fortune Telling

Yasuhiro is a student of Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. He is the Super High School Level Fortune Teller, or Ultimate Clairvoyant in the English localization.

Yasuhiro is cheery, laid-back, and a bit of a conspiracy theorist. He isn't very well-liked by the other students, and Yasuhiro himself has admitted that he is quite cowardly, lazy, slow-witted, and has a habit to act selfishly. Notably, he is mentioned to be very clumsy with money and he has constant problems with massive debts.

__Height:__ 160 cm (5'2")
__Talent:__ Ultimate Animator

A character featured in _Danganronpa 3: The End of Hope's Peak High School_. During his time in Class 77-B at Hope's Peak Academy. He is a member of the Future Foundation and is the Branch Office 10 Director. His responsibility as the director is assistance in reviving education and culture. He, along with the other Future Foundation Directors, is forced to participate in the Final Killing Game.

Ryota is a very timid, insecure, and rather asocial person. He holds anime in very high regard and is extremely passionate about it, considering it his savior during his harsh childhood. His life goal is to give others a similar sense of hope through his anime. However, this led him to shut himself in his room to work, frequently neglecting to eat or sleep as he wanted to spend all his time creating anime. Ryota suffers from extreme anxiety, worrying constantly, and lacks self-confidence, seeing himself as a burden who fails to protect everyone. He has a weak stomach and is easily startled. Though he's very hard on himself, he does his best when given a mission.

alternative: Super High School Level Coach (超高校級のマネージャー)

node.description:
__Height:__ 198cm (6'4)
__Talent:__ Ultimate Team Manager

Nekomaru Nidai is a student of Hope's Peak Academy's Class 77-B and a participant of the Killing School Trip featured in Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair.  

Nekomaru is a vigorous, boisterous, openhearted student who is passionate about supporting athletes. He is very optimistic and his willpower is immeasurable, but he isn't very smart and is bad at lying. He enjoys fighting and often trains with [Akane Owari](https://anilist.co/character/90016/Akane-Owari). Many athletes have become elite and set new records under Nekomaru's guidance. He believes the bonds that are created between a manager and an athlete are the key to success.

Nekomaru was born with a heart defect that left him bedridden and confined to a hospital. The doctor who treated Nekomaru told him that he would only live to be 20. Because of his sickness, he never got to play sports and didn't participate in P.E. in school. He was also teased a lot when he was young, being unable to make friends, and making frequent trips to the hospital.While at the hospital, Nekomaru met a boy named Daisuke, who suffered from the same condition. Daisuke was a team manager. Nekomaru took notice of how many people came to visit him in the hospital. When Daisuke died without seeing the team he had been training reach their championship, Nekomaru was inspired to continue in his footsteps and honor Daisuke's dream by becoming a team manager himself.

Nekomaru quickly gained a reputation as a skilled team manager, turning around several poorly-trained teams and leading them to national recognition. His clients have included baseball stars, figure skaters, and rugby teams. His job ended up developing his muscles and learning a special massage for athletes by using his fingers. He previously attended First Yokoyama High School before enrolling in Hope's Peak Academy.

alternative: Super High School Level Boxer (超高校級のボクサー)

node.description:
__Height:__ 190 cm (6'3")
__Talent:__ Ultimate Boxer

During his time in Class 74th at Hope's Peak Academy.

In Future Arc, he is a member of the Future Foundation and is the Branch Office 6 Director. His responsibility as the director is maintaining public order via suppression of insurrection, inquiry regarding special/particular criminals, etc., including the Special Crime Investigation Unit featured in _Danganronpa Gaiden: Killer Killer_. He, along with the other Future Foundation Directors, is forced to participate in the Final Killing Game.

alternative: Super High School Level Blacksmith (超高校級の鍛冶屋)

node.description:
__Height:__ 180 cm (5'9")
__Talent:__ Ultimate Blacksmith

A former student of Class 76th at Hope's Peak Academy. He is a member of the Future Foundation as the Branch Office 9 Director, responsible for the preparation, development, and management of armaments/weapons. He, along with the other directors, is forced to participate in the Final Killing Game.

Sonosuke is stated to be a "silent type" who avoids talking to others, the only exception being his romantic partner, Ruruka. Sonosuke is incredibly loyal and protective of her, drawing a weapon on anyone who gets close to her. He loves Ruruka's candy and she seems to feed him as a reward, him often resting his head on her lap as he eats and calling the sweets "dewicious". Once Sonosuke's trust is broken, it is very difficult to gain it back, as he believes "once a traitor, always a traitor".

As the Ultimate Blacksmith, Sonosuke is skilled at developing and using different weapons, and he stocks all kinds of hidden weapons inside his coat. His parents, who were also blacksmiths, taught him from a very young age. At the Academy, he opened his own shop to take requests from people to forge any weapons they requested. He created weapons for two purposes, practical and collection. He takes a special interest in weapons that would typically used by ninja. He is also shown to be able to create many kinds of traps, including explosives that can be triggered with a switch or pressure activated traps.

__Talent:__ Ultimate Talent Scout

During his time at Hope's Peak Academy, he was the original homeroom teacher of Class 77-B, being succeeded by [Chisa Yukizome](https://anilist.co/character/90003/Chisa-Yukizome), and a scout for talented students.

He is a member of the Future Foundation and is the Branch Office 3 Director. His responsibility as the director is general HR, including scouting of members and branch heads, distribution of personnel, etc. He, along with the other Future Foundation Directors, is forced to participate in the Final Killing Game.

He was once a former student of Hope's Peak Academy.

__Talent:__ Ultimate Imposter

The Ultimate Imposter is a student of Hope's Peak Academy's Class 77-B, and a participant of the Killing School Trip featured in _Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair_. They impersonate Byakuya Togami as the Ultimate Affluent Progeny.

The Ultimate Imposter's real appearance is that of a person with long, black hair and green eyes with a heavy build. Their age and gender is unknown, but they are able to give off a largely male impression while disguised as Byakuya and even mimic his voice perfectly. In Danganronpa 3, their real voice is quite deep and masculine. However, originally in Danganronpa 2, the brief glimpse of their apparent real voice sounded notably different, more high-pitched and rather gender neutral. The Imposter also refused to go swimming in front of others, which implies that removing their clothes would reveal their true gender. Their true personality is also somewhat unclear as they spend most of their time mimicking someone else's behavior. However, they speak briefly without disguise and it's implied that their real nature is polite and meek. Most notably, they appear to be truly kind and caring, but also quite serious.

The Ultimate Imposter doesn't have a name, family register, relatives, and anything that could link them with their true identity. In order to have their existence acknowledged, they take other people's data and learn it so they can impersonate them flawlessly. No one can tell the difference between the Ultimate Imposter and the real person that they impersonate. According to Monokuma, even their noticeably heavy body build does not affect their ability to fool others. This, along with the fact that they are capable of changing their appearance extremely quickly without anyone noticing, implies that their talent is near superhuman.

alternative: Super High School-Level Student Council President

node.description:
__Height:__ 186cm (6'1")
__Talent:__ Ultimate Student Council President

A character featured in _Danganronpa 3: The End of Hope's Peak High School_. During his time in Class 74th at Hope's Peak Academy, his title was the Ultimate Student Council President. He is later the vice-chairman of the Future Foundation and is the Branch Office 2 Director. His responsibility as the director is the management of the Future Foundation, including construction of new facilities, expansion of the organization, etc. He, along with the other Future Foundation Directors, is forced to participate in the Final Killing Game.

During her time in Class 76th at Hope's Peak Academy.

In Future Arc, she is a member of the Future Foundation and is the Branch Office 8 Director. Her responsibility as the director is assistance in procuring stable food sources. She, along with the other Future Foundation Directors, is forced to participate in the Final Killing Game.

alternative: Chou Koukou Kyuu no Doujin Sakka (超高校級の同人作家)
Super High School Level Doujin Author

node.description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7")
__Talent:__ Creating Doujins

Hifumi is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. He is the Super High School Level Doujin Author (超高校級の同人作家), or Ultimate Fanfic Creator in the English localization.

Hifumi comes across as creepy and perverted, and he has a habit of referencing anime and video games. He loves Buko, the female lead in his favorite anime series, Heretic Angel ☆ Mochi Mochi Princess. He has a particular dislike toward people who supposedly don’t understand the true meaning of doujin. His dream is to ‘save’ other people by making a doujin that will inspire them to create their own.

__Height:__ 133 cm
__Talent:__ Ultimate Cook

Teruteru says he wishes to be known under the title of the Ultimate Chef.

alternative: Super High School Level Neurologist (超高校級の神経学者)

node.description:
__Talent:__ Ultimate Neurologist

A student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 77-A featured in Danganronpa Zero. 

Yasuke is referred to as a “sharp-tongued brainiac” by Monokuma's memo in his profile and he's described as good-looking and intelligent. He is mentioned to be “popular with Reserve Course girls”. However, he is also notably sarcastic, witty and displays a perpetual, disgruntled apathy. Despite his young age, he is a very skilled neurologist and is regarded as an expert neurosurgeon and neuroscientist. He also has a short temper and when he loses it, he can be quick to resort to a stinging and bitter demeanor. While being perfectly capable of being professionally-balanced and cordial, he is also capable of putting other people in their places if not downright scaring or intimidating them.

He is also aloof, enjoying spending time on his own and reading manga. He sees little to no point of respecting others without a good reason to do so and particularly because of this, he is notoriously known for standing up and having a complete disregard or dislike of authority figures. Towards Ryouko, he constantly calls her ugly, however in spite of this he shows some concern towards her on account of her vulnerability and forgetfulness. He considers himself the only one allowed to make fun of her and he feels that he needs to speak up for her. According to Ryouko, he may be cold and blunt, but he doesn't treat her with fake sympathy.

~!Yasuke ends up getting killed by Junko in a fit of despair, as he is one of the people she cares about the most. She stabbed him in the abdomen and then kicked his body until it was mutilated and rendered unrecognizable. Yasuke died believing that Junko did not care about him at all, but in truth, this was not the case. Junko felt painful grief for his death and let him die in despair for the sake of increasing her own despair.!~

The headmaster of Hope's Peak Academy.

~!He is Kyouko's father. He left her when she was a child.!~

__Height:__ 140 cm (4'7")

The Former Director of Hope's Peak, being succeeded by Jin Kirigiri.

In Future Arc, he is the founder and chairman of the Future Foundation and is the Branch Office 1 Director. His responsibility as the director is leadership and deciding the conensus of opinion in the Future Foundation. He, along with the other Future Foundation Directors, is forced to participate in the Final Killing Game.

~!In the end, he is revealed to be the mastermind behind the Final Killing Game and an Ultimate Despair.!~

__Height:__ 162cm (5'3")

The younger sister of Fuyuhiko Kuzuryuu and a Reserve Course Student at Hope's Peak Academy. She is a key subject in the Twilight Syndrome Murder Case featured in _Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair_ and later in _Danganronpa 3: The End of Hope's Peak High School - Despair Arc_.

Natsumi is described as mean, arrogant, smug, and egotistical, but with a subtle way of making people do what she wants. Her family, including Fuyuhiko, believes Natsumi to be more worthy of being the Yakuza heiress than her brother, and she is said by her parents to be more violent than him as well. The Clan even believes that Natsumi is the reincarnation of her deceased uncle, the strongest Kuzuryuu in history. She was given the chance to take her brother's place, but she declined; she doesn't wish to lead the Clan, as she believes she's so amazing because she's Fuyuhiko's sister.

In spite of how she acts, Natsumi is rather insecure, and while she can threaten people, it's implied she isn't truly serious about it. After Fuyuhiko began attending Hope's Peak Academy, Natsumi felt left behind and began calling herself the "Ultimate Little Sister". Even though she wasn't scouted for the Main Course, she never gave up hope and convinced herself that if she just works hard enough, she can be scouted and join her brother one day— even though she knew that's basically impossible.

~!Natsumi had been bullying Mahiru Koizumi since they were in the photography club together at their old school, and still did at the academy. As the conflict escalated, Mahiru's close friend and previous fellow club member, Satou, finally went to confront Natsumi. Satou claimed that she was just going to talk to her, but before she knew it, she strangled Natsumi until she lost consciousness; so before the situation could get worse, Satou killed her.

Natsumi's death was later avenged by Fuyuhiko, who killed Satou in revenge.!~

A member of Hope's Peak Academy's Student Council. Aiko appears to have a childish and naive personality. She's quick to trust others and panics and cries easily.

She and the rest of the council were summoned to the school's old building late at night and forced into a killing game by Junko Enoshima and Mukuro Ikusaba, an event that would later become known as the The Tragedy of Hope's Peak Academy.

~!When the Killing Game started, Aiko tried to protect herself by wildly waving a pan around in a panic to protect herself from Asukasei shooting randomly towards her. Her panic was lessened after Tomohiko reassured her that everything would be okay, causing her to lower her guard for a second. This resulted in her death as Tomohiko stabbed her in the abdomen and then threw her body to distract Asukasei.

Ironically, Aiko would indirectly avenge herself on her killer when he attempted to strangle Asukasei; the latter grabbed the knife from Aiko's corpse to stab Tomohiko in turn.!~

(Source: Danganronpa Wiki, edited)

The Student Council Secretary of Hope's Peak Academy. 

~! She and the rest of the council were forced into a killing game by Junko Enoshima and Mukuro Ikusaba, an event that would later become known as the The Tragedy of Hope's Peak Academy. Karen was the one who started the Student Council Killing Game after she saw the motive that Junko Enoshima presented to her, a photograph of something horrible happening to her mother. Overcome with fear, Karen seized a katana and impaled Ryouta, becoming the first student council member to kill. !~

__Height:__ 163 cm (5'3")

A Hope's Peak Academy Reserve Course Student and a good friend of Mahiru Koizumi. She is a key subject in the Twilight Syndrome Murder Case featured in _Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair_ and later in _Danganronpa 3: The End of Hope's Peak High School - Despair Arc_.

Satou was friends with Mahiru Koizumi in middle school. There, they were part of of the photography club along with Natsumi Kuzuryuu. When Mahiru attended Hope's Peak Academy as the Ultimate Photographer, Sato followed her there by joining the Reserve Course. Satou was a heavily possessive and defensive person who would do anything to protect her friends, especially Mahiru, from being hurt. She had a tendency to act like a leader with her friends, and she was very decisive and unwavering in her thoughts. She also appeared to have a short temper.

~!Satou murdered Natsumi to protect Mahiru, as Satou was convinced she was going to kill Mahiru. After Satou commited the crime, she set up the death to appear like it was caused by a pervert who broke into the school. She denied she ever did this, however, attempting to convince herself and others of this. Soon afterwards, Satou was murdered in revenge by Fuyuhiko Kuzuryuu, Natsumi's brother, by being hit over the head with a metal bat.!~

(Source: Danganronpa Wiki, edited)

A member of Hope's Peak Academy's Student Council. She and the rest of the council were forced into a killing game by Junko Enoshima and Mukuro Ikusaba, an event that would later become known as the The Tragedy of Hope's Peak Academy.

~!Soon after the Killing Game started, Kiriko picked a shovel as her weapon and sprinted down the corridor in order to murder Sousuke. But before she could kill him, Sousuke stabbed Kiriko in the abdomen, leaving her to slowly bleed to death.!~

(Source: Danganronpa Wiki, edited)

alternative: Super High School Level Student Council President (超高校級の生徒会長)

node.description:
__Talent:__ Ultimate Student Council President

Soushun has a righteous personality, a high level of confidence in his friends, and is mentioned to be the type of person who would at least pretend to laugh no matter how bad the joke was. He was quite calm when Mukuro ordered him to kill his fellow student council members, mostly because he trusted them all not to kill each other. Soushun was also a good leader and very persuasive, being able to mitigate the building tension among his classmates until Karen Kisaragi snapped from Junko's "motivation" photo.

~!He and the rest of the council were forced into a killing game by Junko Enoshima and Mukuro Ikusaba, an event that would later become known as the The Tragedy of Hope's Peak Academy.

He was the only survivor of the Tragedy of Hope's Peak Academy, along with Izuru. How he did so is unknown, but it's implied that he had hidden himself while the student council killed each other. During the incident, he sustained a head injury and fell in a comatose-like, unresponsive state, and a month later he was murdered by Yasuke Matsuda in order to keep him quiet about the culprit, Junko Enoshima.!~

A member of Hope's Peak Academy's Student Council. She and the rest of the council were forced into a killing game by Junko Enoshima and Mukuro Ikusaba, an event that would later become known as the The Tragedy of Hope's Peak Academy.

~!When the Killing Game began, Tsubasa and Tarou Kurosaki fled into the hallway. They decided to commit a double suicide and each held a gun to the other's chin. But before they could pull the trigger, Sousuke stabbed Tarou from behind, who fell on Tsubasa, ultimately trapping her. Sousuke then pounded the sharp weapon through Tarou's body and into Tsubasa's using a shovel. Tsubasa screamed and begged for him to stop, but Sousuke continued to drive the object deeper into Tsubasa until she died.!~

(Source: Danganronpa Wiki, edited)

alternative: Super High School Level Secret Agent (超高校級の諜報員)

node.description:
__Talent:__ Ultimate Spy

A student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 77-A.

Yuuto is described as looking childlike and featureless. He has very little presence and he is easily forgotten by other people. He hates being viewed like this; his only solace being the great advantage these traits give him as a secret agent. He can easily gather information and he doesn't even need to hide as he simply isn't noticed. He claims the more dangerous the incident at hand is, the more excited he gets, and he also claims that he's also used to dead bodies due to his job. He can act somewhat arrogant and bragging about his talent, especially around women. He has a great love for sweet pastries, often carrying a bag of them with him and with a tendency to eat them in the middle of a conversation, seemingly not caring at all that other people might find it rude.

Yuuto suffers from self-esteem issues because of his talent, both believing in it and detesting it. He believes that it's only natural to be fixated on it, since it's all he has. Because of his talent, he can't choose his way of living and is stuck doing his duty, always struggling, because giving up would be like rejecting his very existence. He is determined to develop further as a spy and eventually become a legendary spy, so that his lack of presence would be finally completely blown away.

~!Yasuke killed Yuto in order to protect Junko, as he was getting too close to the truth behind The Tragedy of Hope's Peak Academy!~

The Vice President of Hope's Peak Academy's Student Council. Kotomi appears to be quite impulsive and protective of her friends.

~!She and the rest of the council were summoned to the school's old building late at night and forced into a killing game by Junko Enoshima and Mukuro Ikusaba, an event that would later become known as the The Tragedy of Hope's Peak Academy. When Mukuro announced they would kill each other, Kotomi was the first to react, angrily rejecting the idea. But before she could be calmed down, Mukuro shot her, killing her instantly and setting off the killing. This makes Kotomi the very first killing game victim in the Danganronpa timeline.!~

A member of Hope's Peak Academy's Student Council. She and the rest of the council were forced into a killing game by Junko Enoshima and Mukuro Ikusaba, an event that would later become known as the The Tragedy of Hope's Peak Academy. 

Suzuko appears to have a kind and compassionate personality, worrying for other people and saying that they're all friends and thus should not kill each other.

~!She was murdered by Asukasei Hino after begging him to spare her, being shot in the throat while wielding a taser.!~

(Source: Danganronpa Wiki, edited)

A member of Hope's Peak Academy's Student Council. He and the rest of the council were forced into a killing game by Junko Enoshima and Mukuro Ikusaba, an event that would later become known as the The Tragedy of Hope's Peak Academy.

Tomohiko appeared to be a quiet and reserved man; despite being visibly nervous, he reacted calmly when Junko Enoshima revealed she had blackmail material on them. Even during the Killing Game, Tomohiko was able to stay calm enough to trick Aiko into lowering her guard around him. However, he also had a ruthless side.

~!When the killing game started, Tomohiko picked up a knife, only to find himself and Aiko under fire from Asukasei's submachine gun. Pinned down by Asukasei's wild fire, Tomohiko lured a panicking Aiko into a false sense of security by assuring her he would protect her. He then stabbed her in the gut and threw her body at Asukasei to knock him down.

With his assailant briefly incapacitated, Tomohiko ran up and pinned Asukasei down, grinning maniacally as he started to strangle him. However, Asukasei managed to grab the knife that Tomohiko used to kill Aiko and stabbed him in the neck with it, then proceeding to stab Tomohiko multiple times after that.!~

(Source: Danganronpa Wiki)

A member of Hope's Peak Academy's Student Council. He and the rest of the council were forced into a killing game by Junko Enoshima and Mukuro Ikusaba, an event that would later become known as the The Tragedy of Hope's Peak Academy.

Ryouta carried three stuffed animals on his person, impliying that he had a soft spot for plushies.

~!Soon after the killing began, Ryouta chose to pick up a shotgun, intending to murder Junko and Mukuro to avenge Kotomi's death. Sousuke Ichino attempted to take the gun away from him, and they tussled over it before Soushun told them to stop. But when Sousuke let go of the gun, Ryouta stumbled backwards and was stabbed from behind by Karen, killing him.!~

(Source: Danganronpa Wiki, edited)

A member of Hope's Peak Academy's Student Council. He and the rest of the council were forced into a killing game by Junko Enoshima and Mukuro Ikusaba, an event that would later become known as the The Tragedy of Hope's Peak Academy.

~!He was murdered off-screen during the killing in _Danganronpa 3_, however he is likely the boy shown in _Danganronpa/Zero_ who beat another boy, most likely Shouji Yokou, to death with a chair. He was then ambushed by another council member, most likely Asukasei Hino, being blinded by glass shards in his eyes before eventually being killed by an unspecified female Student Council member, possibly Suzuko Kashiki, wielding a cleaver.!~

(Source: Danganronpa Wiki)

A member of Hope's Peak Academy's Student Council. He and the rest of the council were forced into a killing game by Junko Enoshima and Mukuro Ikusaba, an event that would later become known as the The Tragedy of Hope's Peak Academy.

Tarou appears to be a calm and kind person. Similar to his girlfriend, Tsubasa, Tarou is pacifistic, refusing to kill other students. He is portrayed as a gentle and loving boyfriend.

~!When the Killing Game began, Tsubasa and Tarou Kurosaki fled into the hallway. They decided to commit a double suicide and each held a gun to the other's chin. But before they could pull the trigger, Sousuke stabbed Tarou from behind, killing him. His body then fell onto Tsubasa, ultimately trapping her.!~

(Source: Danganronpa Wiki, edited)

A member of Hope's Peak Academy's Student Council. He and the rest of the council were forced into a killing game by Junko Enoshima and Mukuro Ikusaba, an event that would later become known as the The Tragedy of Hope's Peak Academy.

Prior to the beginning of the Killing Game, Sousuke tries to act reasonable and obey Soushun Murasame's orders. He shows a somewhat aggressive demeanor, being quick to confront Ryota over his attempt to avenge Kotomi's death; additionally, he is one of the first students to grab a weapon once the killing starts.

~!After the Killing Game started, Sousuke was one of the first to grab a weapon, taking a large spear. He fled into the hallway and was pursued by Kiriko Nishizawa, forcing him to stab her in self-defense. As Kiriko bled out on the floor, Sousuke was horrified about what he had done, asking why she made him do that and confessing that he loved her, his words implying he never told her about his feelings.

Later, Sousuke killed both Tarou and Tsubasa as they attempted to commit a lovers' suicide, impaling the former with his spear. Seemingly fueled by envious rage for the couple after what happened to Kiriko, he screamed at Tsubasa to shut up before driving his spear through her by hitting it with Kiriko's shovel. He began crying uncontrollably after Tsubasa died, unaware that Karen Kisaragi was approaching behind him with a chainsaw. She proceeded to kill him offscreen.!~

(Source: Danganronpa Wiki, edited)

A member of Hope's Peak Academy's Student Council. He and the rest of the council were forced into a killing game by Junko Enoshima and Mukuro Ikusaba, an event that would later become known as the The Tragedy of Hope's Peak Academy.

Asukasei appears to be a serious person, not seeming to smile much even in ordinary situations. Despite appearing relatively calm during the beginning of the Killing Game, he quickly becomes aggressive and panicked once the killing begins.

~!When Karen Kisaragi started the Killing Game, Asukasei fearfully picked up a gun and started shooting at Aiko Umesawa and Tomohiko. After he saw Tomohiko kill Aiko, he panicked even more and continued to shoot, but was knocked over and disarmed by Aiko's lifeless body. Tomohiko then proceeded to strangle Asukasei, but Asukasei stabbed Tomohiko in the neck with the same knife that was used to kill Aiko. Asukasei then got on top of Tomohiko and stabbed him multiple times.

Asukasei ended up being the assumed sole survivor after killing Suzuko with a handgun, but Izuru approached him and told him he couldn't beat him. Asukasei didn't listen and charged at Izuru with a chainsaw; in turn, Izuru pushed Asukasei and sent him flying backwards against a window. The chainsaw fell in front of Asukasei, and he fell on it, decapitating him. Before Asukasei died, he managed to fire a shot that grazed Izuru's right cheek.!~

(Source: Danganronpa Wiki)
